name: git-rbx-viewer
description: Shows rbxm/rbxl files as instance trees with properties, and their diffs as a tree of changes, as the git-rbx Studio diff viewer shows them.

gitRbx.studioContentPath.markdownDescription: Roblox Studio's `content` folder, for class icons. Found automatically in the default install location.

gitRbx.assetPreviews.markdownDescription: Preview the assets that Content and ContentId properties point at. Roblox assets load from Roblox's public thumbnails API; `rbxasset://` paths from your Studio install.
